title: TABLECONTENT CONTENTFORMAT text-style hard-pointer output

scope.operation: Emit and remap non-null CONTENTFORMAT text-style references for style-level and per-content formats.
scope.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.101.3: CONTENTFORMAT is used in CELLSTYLEMAP, table entities and TABLECONTENT; group 340 is a hard pointer to the text-style handle.
scope.previousGap: The TABLECONTENT writer refused every non-null m_textStyleHandle and, if that gate were relaxed alone, would write the source handle without resolving it to the emitted STYLE table record.
scope.profiles: Generated AC1027 TABLECONTENT records: 1x1 and 2x2; style scopes 1 through 4; ASCII and binary DXF. Each record includes one style-scope and one per-content CONTENTFORMAT reference to the same generated STYLE record.

implementation: Permit non-null CONTENTFORMAT text-style handles through TABLECONTENT profile validation.

Before writing group 340, require that the referenced source handle was emitted as a STYLE record and resolve it to the final written table handle; an installed reference resolver must agree with that emitted identity.
Keep a null style handle encoded as zero. Missing or unresolved non-null hard pointers fail the write.

evidence.physicalWire: Across all four scopes and both record shapes/encodings, the independent group walker finds exactly two CONTENTFORMAT group-340 values and verifies that both resolve to the emitted STYLE handle.
evidence.typedReadback: Fresh import confirms the selected style-scope and per-content m_textStyleHandle each equal the emitted STYLE table-record handle.
evidence.missingTarget: Removing the referenced STYLE provider causes export refusal; a pre-existing destination sentinel, TABLECONTENT metadata and caller handle remain unchanged.
evidence.retry: Restoring the STYLE provider permits same-adapter retry, and fresh import verifies the group-340 target.

remaining: P5 remains open; other CONTENTFORMAT domains/property combinations, CELLSTYLEMAP profiles, native TABLE semantics and rendering are not qualified.
This slice does not close the physical mechanical source VISUALSTYLE carrier gate or P4 whole-document closure.
